correctness.rationale: From the three exact quadrics, all 3x3 Jacobian minors are the 32 unit-coefficient products involving one coordinate from each of three distinct groups. The radical consists of same-pair products and those triple-group monomials. On every coordinate fixed-point chart, eliminating the nonzero partner gives two quadrics and 12 local cross-group Jacobian minors; the quotient has one nonzero common quadratic tau annihilated by the maximal ideal. Thus exactly one square-zero embedded unit at each of eight points, no extra nilradical elsewhere. The 24-line graph has 8 vertices of valency 6, so reduced genus 17 and full Jacobian genus 9. Exact code checks integral minors and finite-field ranks; the proof is symbolic in all characteristics.

value.rationale: The C4 cut variety is a natural canonical toric model in statistics and phylogenetics. Its previously studied reduced toric singular support cannot detect Jacobian scheme nilpotents. The complete length-eight embedded module and arithmetic-genus correction are precise intrinsic geometric invariants relevant to singularity/deformation computations, with an exact local derivation rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The result is a meaningful scheme-theoretic boundary to the known support classification.
